summary: Tested Admin Dashboard clickable stat cards and profile photo upload features. All backend APIs (9/9) and frontend UI tests passed successfully.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/admin/dashboard-stats returns correct structure with active_valets, parked_vehicles, tips, totals
Backend: active_valets array contains id, name, phone_number, email, driver_license_number
Backend: parked_vehicles array contains id, license_plate, phone_number, tag_number, zone_label, parked_by_name
Backend: dashboard-stats requires authentication (401 without token)
Backend: dashboard-stats accessible by admin role
Backend: POST /api/admin/profile/photo accepts file upload and returns profile_photo URL
Backend: Profile photo persists in GET /api/auth/me response
Backend: profile/photo requires authentication
Backend: GET /api/auth/me returns profile_photo field
Frontend: Admin Panel loads with 3 stat cards (Active Valets, Vehicles, Tips Today)
Frontend: Active Valets card (data-testid=card-active-valets) is clickable
Frontend: Clicking Active Valets opens modal (data-testid=modal-valets) showing valet name, phone, email, license number
Frontend: Vehicles card (data-testid=card-vehicles) is clickable
Frontend: Clicking Vehicles opens modal (data-testid=modal-vehicles) showing parked vehicles or 'No vehicles parked today'
Frontend: Tips card (data-testid=card-tips) is clickable
Frontend: Clicking Tips opens modal (data-testid=modal-tips) showing tip breakdown or placeholder message
Frontend: Close button (data-testid=close-detail-modal) closes all modals
Frontend: Clicking backdrop closes modals
Frontend: My Profile section expands with profile photo upload area (data-testid=profile-photo-area)
Frontend: Profile photo area has cursor:pointer style indicating clickability
Frontend: Profile photo displays when uploaded (base64 data URL)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin and valet data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin dashboard stat cards feature is fully working. Key data-testids: card-active-valets, card-vehicles, card-tips (stat cards), modal-valets, modal-vehicles, modal-tips (detail modals), close-detail-modal (close button), profile-photo-area (profile photo upload). Admin has 1 active valet (Jennifer Smith) and 0 vehicles parked today. Tips data is placeholder (payment integration not live). Profile photo uploads as base64 and stores in MongoDB user document. Admin panel button testid is 'admin-panel-button' (not 'admin-panel-btn').
